desc:
⛳ NEW: CHAOS GOLF! Mini golf with friends - everyone plays at once! Before each hole, every player secretly builds a sneaky obstacle on the lane. Then tee off and sink your ball first!

11 board, card and party games to play with friends - bots fill every empty seat. 2-6 players.

🎲 GAMES
• Chaos Golf - build traps, tee off (NEW)
• Rotropolis - build your own city
• Zero Hero - lowest cards win
• Sink the Fleet - real warships
• Vault Breaker - crack the gem code
• Ludo - race across a giant board
• Four in a Row - connect four
• Mau-Mau - match suit or number
• Yacht - roll for a full house
• Memory - find the pairs
• Sink or Swim - card game on a jungle river

🌙 GAME NIGHT MODE - play several games in a row and crown the champion!

🍅 TAUNTS - tomatoes, disco bombs and fart balls. Just for fun!

⭐ Game Night Pass, daily streak, skins and cosmetics.

👍 Like & favorite - at 1,000 likes there's ADMIN ABUSE!
